description: Output contract every portal automation writes (result.json), read by the orchestrator (UiPath, or the Apex adapter) to decide retry / business-exception / success. Written once via writeResult(); crash-guarded so a FAILURE result exists even on a hard crash. Invalid data is always FAILURE + hasInvalidData (NOT_SUBMITTED routes to the success path and BE never sees hasInvalidData).

fields.hasInvalidData: OPTIONAL — true only for data-validation failures
fields.description: OPTIONAL — human-readable failure detail; what the orchestrator logs / the Apex job row shows. NOT an invalid-data signal (only hasInvalidData is) and never sent to BE
fields.invalidCodes: OPTIONAL — bad ICD/CPT codes, or [] for member/facility
fields.authScreenshots: OPTIONAL — section screenshot paths for PDF generation
fields.postSubmit: OPTIONAL — post-submit page diagnostics (see postSubmit shape)
fields.receipt: OPTIONAL — what the PORTAL acknowledged (submissionDate, status, decisionDate, notes), verbatim; a SIBLING of postSubmit, never nested. Absent = nothing acknowledged; {} = acknowledged, no fields
fields.error: OPTIONAL — only on FAILURE; cleared if a fallback upgrades to SUBMITTED. Stripped into debug.json (not result.json) except OtpRequested and a failed facility-send, so put anything a human must see in description too
fields.tracePath: OPTIONAL — Playwright trace.zip path, patched onto result.json by closeBrowser after the fact (not part of the writeResult call)

postSubmit.title: page title
postSubmit.evidencePdfPath: OPTIONAL — chart-grade evidence PDF; rides confirmSubmit as evidencePath when APPROVED
postSubmit.expirationDate: OPTIONAL — the auth's expiry, portal-rendered, verbatim
